description: Defines the WebSocketInflater class for decompressing DEFLATE compressed data, including its internal buffer management and input queue handling.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater
classes.description: A class for inflating (decompressing) data compressed with DEFLATE, managing input/output buffers and state.

methods.name: WebSocketInflater
methods.description: Constructor with specified input and output buffer capacities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the inflater with a specified window size.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds compressed data bytes to the inflater.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Flushes the input data to prepare for output.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves decompressed output data of specified size.

methods.name: CurrentOutputSize
methods.description: Returns the size of current decompressed output.
